notes.title: New Update: Endless Mode Sagas Arrives
notes.notes:
[h2][b]New Update: Endless Mode Sagas Arrives[/b][/h2][p]Long before your people learned to summon flame from stone and spark, there were those who carried a single stolen fire through the endless winter. The elders speak of an age when the cold never lifted and the suns warmth was but a fleeting dream. From the safety of their caves, small tribes would step into the frozen wild, guarding the flame and seeking the wisdom to make it their own.[/p][p]These journeys became the Sagas, tales told in smoke and shadow, where each band faced trials no single winter could hold. Some found blessings that carried them far, others were marked by curses that shadowed their every step. Champions would rise, fall, and return only if the spirits willed it.[/p][p]Now your people gather once more in the shamans circle. The embers of old fires glow faintly in the dark, and the stories begin again. You will walk the paths of those who came before, shaping the fate of the flame and of the Tribe until the last ember fades and this Saga is ready to be told.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44958205/cf9796ff07bf0374e86cbccbebc0207ed6e3d987.png"][/img][/p][h3]Endless Mode Sagas[/h3][p]Endless Mode Sagas introduces an entirely new way to play. A roguelite experience built for players who want long-term stakes, unpredictable challenges, and meaningful decisions that echo across multiple games in the same Saga.[/p][p]Each choice you make in Endless Mode carries forward, building your Tribe’s story over the time of the Saga. Every loss teaches you something. Every victory reshapes the tools you have for the battles ahead. And because no two Sagas unfold the same way, each one feels like a unique legend of survival.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Roguelite Saga Mechanics[/b][/p][list][*][p]Characters you use in a game are gone for the rest of that Saga unless you revive them with precious Shiny Rocks, at an increasing cost.[/p][/*][*][p]The Fire Starter discovery cannot be completed in this mode, so every upgrade is critical to push your survived day count higher.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Saga Persistent Enhancements[/b][/p][list][*][p]At the start and end of every run, choose a lasting upgrade for your Tribe. Each costs 1–3 Firepits, and with the Fire Starter discovery locked away, every choice shapes your Saga’s outcome.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44958205/d422b1222e44f341897180cd7b4de3989cdc5cc4.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Mammoth Misfortunes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Spend all your Firepits and you will face two harsh debuffs. Choose your curse and adapt to survive.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44958205/52e8f404365b02bad10da3a48e3b8eb2098918cc.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Massive Shop Variety[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Shop refreshes after every run, offering new tools and strategies. Win to unlock new Shop items. Lose, and you may still earn a new item or a Misfortune.[/p][/*][*][p]With so many combinations to discover, every Saga feels fresh and unpredictable.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44958205/2c4574d26113555e9c5d892f072fe9108181ca6d.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p][b]How to Unlock Endless Mode Sagas[/b]
Purchase the Endless Winter Pack in the Mammoth Market. Start a new game, go to Game Setup, set Fire Knowledge Tree Difficulty to Endless, and use the new UI to begin your Saga.
[/p][p][b]Share your best runs, shop combinations, and survival tales with the community. If you encounter any issues, please use the in-game bug report form in the settings menu.[/b][/p]

notes.title: Major Update - New Character / Content Packs
notes.notes:
[b]Big Update Announcement:[/b] Dead Valley & Endless Winter

Hey Tribe, I'm thrilled to announce a major update that brings some fresh, fun twists to your survival journey! First up is the[b] Dead Valley Character Pack[/b]—I've added seven brand-new playable Tribe members, each packing unique abilities and quirky playstyles to shake up your survival strategy. Shoutout to guest artist [b]A.R. Curry[/b] for bringing these fierce characters to life!

But wait, there's more. I've also rolled out the [b]Endless Winter Fire Knowledge Tree[/b]. This isn't just another challenge—it's a brutal, never-ending test of your resourcefulness. Unlock the Fire Starter Discovery to grab essential supplies, and although the wood removal rate caps at Day 13, your survival adventure goes on indefinitely. How long can you endure the relentless cold?

The update is also packed with visual polish changes and bug fixes!

And the icing on the cake? The game is now available on iPhone, so you can dive into the action anytime, anywhere.

I can't wait to see how you tackle these new challenges and push your survival skills to the limit. Enjoy the update and try to stay warm!

Check out all the ways to play over at [url=https://thunkboardgames.com/digital]https://thunkboardgames.com/digital[/url]

-Dustin

notes.title: Update Notes for 8/21/2024
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where Kara and Tara could not use their player picking skill on Revived Tribe Members.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Coop Player Turn panel would show for a character that was incapacitated.
[*] Fixed a bug where the first night, Night Event Log could persist across back to back games.
[*] Fixed a bug where Nibna could use her heal skill with less than 2 Health.
[*] Adjusted UI in Character Select screen. Game Setup options have been moved to their own panel and a button to see the panel now replaces their old location.
[*] Added in Hard Day Tracker mode, toggleable in the Game Setup options. This increases the amount of wood that comes out of the Firepit each Morning. Gain additional Shiny Rocks when turned on.
[*] [REDACTED] polish and changes. Game is easier while scaling to be harder and Gronk Bonks now speed up the game.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 7/22/2024
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44958205/0266e652c81c670d14a5635f6c57679ba48e51f5.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Added a Local Coop panel to the Character Select screen. This allows you to add/remove player names and assign them to picked/randomized character slots.
[*] When starting the game from this panel, it enables local coop mode. In this mode, you will see a new color-coded Player's Turn reminder with the character owner's Player Name pop up between each character's turn to remind you of the owner.
[*] This is a great new feature to keep track of who's who when you're playing Hot Seat or Steam Remote Play!
[/list]
